violations.description: Product images missing alt text — screen readers cannot convey image content to users
Text color #999999 on white background (#ffffff) provides approximately 2.85:1 contrast ratio, failing the required 4.5:1 minimum for normal text
Email input field has no associated <label> element and no aria-label or aria-labelledby attribute
Link text 'click here' is not descriptive out of context — purpose cannot be determined from link text alone
Video autoplays with audio and has no controls attribute, preventing users from pausing or stopping the audio
Heading hierarchy skips levels — page uses h1 then jumps directly to h4, bypassing h2 and h3, breaking document structure
The <html> element is missing the lang attribute; assistive technologies cannot determine the default language of the page
Color (red) is used as the sole visual indicator for error messages and breaking news urgency — no icon, no text prefix, no pattern
Modal dialog creates a keyboard trap — focus enters the modal but cannot escape via the Escape key or any keyboard mechanism; no close button is provided
Data table uses <td> elements for column headers instead of <th> elements; screen readers cannot associate data cells with their column or row headers
Required form fields have no visual or programmatic indication of being required — no asterisk, no aria-required='true', and no required attribute
Error message is identified only through red color styling; no role='alert', no 'Error:' text prefix, and no icon to indicate error status programmatically
Custom checkbox widget is implemented as a <div> with no role='checkbox' attribute, no aria-checked state management, and no keyboard Enter/Space event handlers
Link to PDF document does not indicate the file type or file size; users may not be prepared for a file download or format change
Custom checkbox is not operable via keyboard — no keydown event listener for Space or Enter keys despite having tabindex='0'
Session expires after inactivity without any prior accessible warning — no countdown notification, no aria-live announcement, and no option to extend the session before expiry
Complex blood pressure trend chart rendered on <canvas> has no text alternative, no aria-label with data summary, no associated data table, and no role='img' with description
Reschedule and Cancel appointment buttons have a CSS size of 18x18 pixels, below the WCAG 2.2 minimum target size of 24x24 CSS pixels
Flash sale banner uses a CSS animation (flashSale) cycling at 0.2 seconds per iteration — equivalent to 5 Hz, exceeding the 3 flashes per second threshold and posing seizure risk
Audio-only content (instructor welcome message) is provided without a text transcript; deaf and hard-of-hearing users have no access to the audio content
The main page heading is presented as an image of text (hero-heading.png) with alt='' making it invisible to screen readers; real HTML text with styling should be used instead
Global CSS rule '* { outline: none; }' removes the visible focus indicator from all interactive elements — keyboard users cannot determine which element currently has focus
Auto-advancing course carousel moves every 2 seconds with no pause, stop, or hide mechanism — users with cognitive disabilities or motion sensitivity cannot stop the movement
